name: Targa Florio 1973 - Madonie Stage 2
description: The Piccolo Madonie: seventy-two kilometres of Sicilian mountain road behind Cerda, reckoned at some seven hundred corners a lap, and the course of the Targa Florio from 1951 until the race was finally stopped in 1977. It counted for the World Sportscar Championship until 1973, the year this version depicts. The mod cuts the lap into five stages driven in winter light; this is stage 2, 19.9 kilometres of it.
author: Abulzz
